rewrite_rules.claim_boundary: manual planning surface; no retired-source acceptance claim
manual planning surface; no ABI parity claim

support_boundary: The analyzer parses checked-in migration input JSON and source text to produce diagnostics and rewrite plans. It does not accept retired Objective-C 2 source as compiler input, does not claim Swift or C++ ABI parity, and does not treat standalone report output as a capability basis.
fail_closed_conditions: input contract_id is missing or unsupported
source path or packaged execution evidence is outside checked-in repository paths
Swift or C++ foreign interface declarations are missing
unsafe mixed-image loading markers are present
rewrite edits drift from the source text before application
